Our vision is to ensure progress and build a safer future for humanity. Leadership Leading the Way in Cybersecurity Tomer Weingarten Chief Executive Officer, Co-Founder Read Bio X Chief Executive Officer, Co-Founder Tomer Weingarten Tomer Weingarten is co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of SentinelOne, the global leader in AI security, and is responsible for the company’s direction, products, and strategy. Over the last decade, Tomer has transformed the cybersecurity industry through his vision and focus on innovation. An engineer by trade, Tomer has deep programming, database, and machine learning experience which he has leveraged to develop cutting-edge solutions that bring together the power of AI, data, and cloud in the world’s most advanced cybersecurity platform that protects the entire enterprise. Earlier in her career, Sonalee held senior finance and strategy roles at Hewlett Packard Enterprise, where she led corporate development, M&A, and investor relations, and spent nearly two decades in global investment banking at Goldman Sachs, Barclays, Jefferies, and RBC, advising companies on IPOs, M&A, and capital structure. Ana also served on the boards of several high-growth SaaS and security companies.
